subject: mathematics
title: Shape Trail · Q1 W01 D03
objective: Recognize and describe points, lines, line segments, rays, and special line relationships.
introduction: Milo is tracing kite strings! Help him tell a line from a ray.

activities.instruction: Watch how a point, a segment, and a ray are different.
activities.content: A point marks a location. A line segment has two endpoints. A ray has one endpoint and continues in one direction. Parallel lines do not meet; perpendicular lines meet to form a right angle.

items.prompt: Which of these marks one exact location?

options.text: a long straight path that never ends
a wavy curve with no endpoints

items.explanation: A point marks one exact location. A curve, a number sentence, and an endless path do not.

items.prompt: Which of these has two endpoints?

options.text: a wavy curve with no endpoints

items.explanation: A line segment has two endpoints. A curve can have none, and a color has no endpoints at all.

items.prompt: Which of these has one endpoint and goes on in one direction?

options.text: a long straight path that never ends

items.explanation: A ray has one endpoint and continues in one direction. An endless straight path has no endpoint.

items.prompt: Which pair of lines never meets, no matter how far they go?

options.text: a long straight path that never ends
a wavy curve with no endpoints

items.explanation: Parallel lines stay the same distance apart and never meet. Perpendicular lines meet to form a right angle.

items.prompt: Which statement about points and lines is true?

options.text: a long straight path that never ends
a wavy curve with no endpoints

items.explanation: A point marks one location. A ray has one endpoint, and an endless straight path has none.
